options.label: Options

decision.label: Decision

experiment.label: Experiment

learning.label: Learning
learning.title: Learning
learning.body: The reusable lesson a person confirms after an outcome, kept for the decisions that follow.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.intro: The Critic looks for what could make this choice regrettable: unsupported assumptions, contradictory evidence, hidden dependencies, failure modes, causal claims and missing success criteria.

record.title: Decision
record.intro: What was chosen, what was set aside, the arguments on both sides, the uncertainty that remains, the success criteria and what would bring the team back to this choice.

meta.title: Kollio {'|'} From ideas to shared projects
meta.description: Test your ideas against reality, develop them and bring the right people together.

auth.getStartedNote: You sign in, then land in your team’s private workspace.

hero.title: An idea deserves more than a conversation.
hero.description: A place to test your instincts against reality, keep track of every step and build with the right people.

idea.title: Start with an idea.
idea.description: A problem, an intuition, a possibility. Give it a starting point.

challenge.title: Put it to the test.
challenge.description: Explicit constraints and sources to help you decide what comes next.

team.title: Grow it together.
team.description: Every contribution matters. Every step keeps its history.

meta.title: Kollio {'|'} Test your initiatives against reality
meta.description: The private workspace where your team tests its initiatives, keeps a record of every decision and brings the right people together.

hero.description: Test your initiatives against reality, keep a record of every decision and bring the right people together in a private space.

context.title: Shared context
context.description: Constraints, objectives and what the company already knows feed every analysis, in one place.

decisions.title: Explainable decisions
decisions.description: Every step keeps its author, its message and the reason behind it. The thread stays readable.

ai.title: AI under your control
ai.description: The AI proposes, argues its case and stays inspectable. The decision always stays with the team.

landing.trust: Your initiatives, decisions and conversations stay inside your private workspace.

method.title: Three steps, from instinct to decision.
method.description: Each step leaves a record: what was deposited, what challenged it, and what was decided. Nothing gets lost.

capture.title: Deposit the initiative.
capture.description: A title, a pitch. Constraint analysis starts right away.

challenge.title: Put it to the test.
challenge.description: Explicit constraints, sources, open questions. Every objection can be discussed, never buried.

decide.title: Decide, and keep the record.
decide.description: The team settles it, moves forward or turns back. Every decision stays in the initiative’s thread.

finalCta.title: From instinct to decision, with your whole team.
